name: Portfolio Chart
description: A brokerage-grade price chart: the line rises in a wave, figures count up out of a blur, ranges morph, and a crosshair dims the future. Dark or light.
usage:
import { ChartPortfolio } from "@/components/design-for-ai/chart-portfolio";

<ChartPortfolio
  name="Acme Treasury"
  ticker="ACMT"
  currency="GBP"
  locale="en-GB"
  data={{ "1M": points }} // { t: epochMs, v: price, vol: volume }[]
/>

props.name: ticker
props.description: Ticker shown in mono; its first two letters make the mark.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency for all money formatting.

props.name: data
props.description: Series per range: { t, v, vol }. Missing ranges fall back to demo data.

props.name: height
props.description: Chart height at desktop; mobile uses 72%.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black card with white ink, or a white card with near-black ink. Up and down colours adjust for contrast.
